column1: # tools/planted_violations.tsv: one planted violation per check (tools/planted_violations.py).
# Each row: the plant, the job's own earlier steps it needs (setup), the step's own command, and the
# regex the red output must match. Escapes in cells: \n newline, \t tab, \xHH a byte, \\ a backslash.
# A row's command is checked against the step text on every run (PLANT-STALE when it drifts).
# The whole-suite functional rows plant in the case prologue (rocketnet_functional_run_named), so every case
# fails at the plant before it does any work: the first case in suite order is red at the plant whatever the
# load, and no earlier case can fail first (a plant in one mid-suite case read green under load: the runner
# stops at the first failure in suite order).

column4: Replay all corpora under NDEBUG
column8:
cmake -B build-fuzz -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=clang -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER=clang++ -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS="-fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link,address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer" -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link,address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer"
cmake --build build-fuzz --target rocketnet_dev --parallel 8
mkdir -p bin
# the replay step below replays exactly this list; the XDP filter
# harness links the filter as host C and is built after the loop
harnesses="rocketnet_fuzz rocketnet_fuzz_connect_token rocketnet_fuzz_receive_structured rocketnet_fuzz_message rocketnet_fuzz_token_private rocketnet_fuzz_round_trip rocketnet_fuzz_config rocketnet_fuzz_server_transport rocketnet_fuzz_client_transport rocketnet_fuzz_session rocketnet_fuzz_xdp_frame rocketnet_fuzz_uring_recvmsg rocketnet_fuzz_gateway_netlink rocketnet_fuzz_endpoint rocketnet_fuzz_xdp_filter"
echo "NDEBUG_HARNESSES=$harnesses" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
for src in $harnesses; do
  if [ "$src" = rocketnet_fuzz_xdp_filter ]; then continue; fi
  clang++ -g -O1 -std=c++17 \
    -ffp-contract=off \
    -DROCKETNET_DEV=1 -DNDEBUG \
    -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
    -Isodium -Isdk -Itests "tests/fuzz/${src}.cpp" build-fuzz/librocketnet_dev.a \
    -lbpf -lxdp -luring -lpthread \
    -o "bin/${src}_ndebug"
done
# the XDP filter target links the filter as host C (tests/xdp_host/), instrumented like the library
clang -g -O1 -std=gnu11 -ffreestanding -ffp-contract=off -D__linux__ -D__BPF__ -DNDEBUG \
  -fsanitize=fuzzer-no-link,address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
  -Itests/xdp_host -Isdk "-DROCKETNET_XDP_FILTER_SOURCE=\"$PWD/sdk/xdp/server_xdp.c\"" \
  -c tests/xdp_host/server_xdp_host.c -o bin/xdp_host_fuzz_ndebug.o
clang++ -g -O1 -std=c++17 \
  -ffp-contract=off \
  -DROCKETNET_DEV=1 -DNDEBUG -DROCKETNET_FUZZ_XDP_FILTER_HOST=1 \
  -fsanitize=fuzzer,address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -fno-omit-frame-pointer \
  -Isodium -Isdk -Itests tests/fuzz/rocketnet_fuzz_xdp_filter.cpp bin/xdp_host_fuzz_ndebug.o build-fuzz/librocketnet_dev.a \
  -lbpf -lxdp -luring -lpthread \
  -o bin/rocketnet_fuzz_xdp_filter_ndebug
column9:
# every harness the build step built, each against its own corpus;
# one failing replay never hides the rest (each is named, then the
# step fails)
failed=0
for harness in $NDEBUG_HARNESSES; do
  corpus="tests/fuzz/corpus${harness#rocketnet_fuzz}"
  if ! "./bin/${harness}_ndebug" "$corpus"/* > "fuzz-ndebug-$harness.log" 2>&1; then
    echo "NDEBUG replay failed: $harness"
    tail -n 30 "fuzz-ndebug-$harness.log"
    failed=1
  fi
done
exit $failed

column4: Check the version sites agree
column9:
set -euo pipefail

fail=0

check_branch() {
  branch_name="$1"
  full="$2"
  major="$3"
  minor="$4"
  patch="$5"
  if [ -z "$full" ] || [ -z "$major" ] || [ -z "$minor" ] || [ -z "$patch" ]; then
    echo "::error::Could not extract the $branch_name version from sdk/rocketnet.h (FULL='$full', MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH='$major.$minor.$patch') — the version macros moved and this check did not follow."
    fail=1
    return
  fi
  echo "$branch_name: ROCKETNET_VERSION_FULL=$full  MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH=$major.$minor.$patch"
  if [ "$branch_name" = "development" ]; then
    # the development branch names itself rather than numbering
    # itself; its integers are the 255.255.255 sentinel
    if [ "$full" != "dev" ] || [ "$major.$minor.$patch" != "255.255.255" ]; then
      echo "::error::The development version must be \"dev\" with the 255.255.255 sentinel (got $full and $major.$minor.$patch)."
      fail=1
    fi
    return
  fi
  # Derive the optional prerelease from FULL; there is no public
  # prerelease macro in the final API.
  if [[ ! "$full" =~ ^v([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)\.([0-9]+)(-([0-9A-Za-z][0-9A-Za-z.-]*))?$ ]]; then
    echo "::error::Invalid shipping ROCKETNET_VERSION_FULL: $full"
    fail=1
    return
  fi
  numeric="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}.${BASH_REMATCH[2]}.${BASH_REMATCH[3]}"
  prerelease="${BASH_REMATCH[5]:-}"
  echo "shipping prerelease: $prerelease"
  if [ "$numeric" != "$major.$minor.$patch" ]; then
    echo "::error::ROCKETNET_VERSION_FULL ($full) does not match ROCKETNET_VERSION_MAJOR/MINOR/PATCH ($major.$minor.$patch)."
    fail=1
  fi
}

# the two branches, in file order: the shipping one first
shipping_full=$(awk '/#if !ROCKETNET_DEV/,/#else/' sdk/rocketnet.h | sed -nE 's/.*ROCKETNET_VERSION_FULL[[:space:]]+"([^"]+)".*/\1/p' | head -n1)
shipping_major=$(awk '/#if !ROCKETNET_DEV/,/#else/' sdk/rocketnet.h | sed -nE 's/.*ROCKETNET_VERSION_MAJOR[[:space:]]+([0-9]+).*/\1/p' | head -n1)
shipping_minor=$(awk '/#if !ROCKETNET_DEV/,/#else/' sdk/rocketnet.h | sed -nE 's/.*ROCKETNET_VERSION_MINOR[[:space:]]+([0-9]+).*/\1/p' | head -n1)
shipping_patch=$(awk '/#if !ROCKETNET_DEV/,/#else/' sdk/rocketnet.h | sed -nE 's/.*ROCKETNET_VERSION_PATCH[[:space:]]+([0-9]+).*/\1/p' | head -n1)

dev_full=$(awk '/#else \/\/\/? !ROCKETNET_DEV/,/#endif \/\/\/? !ROCKETNET_DEV/' sdk/rocketnet.h | sed -nE 's/.*ROCKETNET_VERSION_FULL[[:space:]]+"([^"]+)".*/\1/p' | head -n1)
dev_major=$(awk '/#else \/\/\/? !ROCKETNET_DEV/,/#endif \/\/\/? !ROCKETNET_DEV/' sdk/rocketnet.h | sed -nE 's/.*ROCKETNET_VERSION_MAJOR[[:space:]]+([0-9]+).*/\1/p' | head -n1)
dev_minor=$(awk '/#else \/\/\/? !ROCKETNET_DEV/,/#endif \/\/\/? !ROCKETNET_DEV/' sdk/rocketnet.h | sed -nE 's/.*ROCKETNET_VERSION_MINOR[[:space:]]+([0-9]+).*/\1/p' | head -n1)
dev_patch=$(awk '/#else \/\/\/? !ROCKETNET_DEV/,/#endif \/\/\/? !ROCKETNET_DEV/' sdk/rocketnet.h | sed -nE 's/.*ROCKETNET_VERSION_PATCH[[:space:]]+([0-9]+).*/\1/p' | head -n1)

check_branch "shipping" "$shipping_full" "$shipping_major" "$shipping_minor" "$shipping_patch"
check_branch "development" "$dev_full" "$dev_major" "$dev_minor" "$dev_patch"

case "${GITHUB_REF:-}" in
  refs/tags/*)
    tag_version="$GITHUB_REF_NAME"
    echo "release tag: $tag_version"
    if [ "$tag_version" != "$shipping_full" ]; then
      echo "::error::Tag $GITHUB_REF_NAME does not match the shipping version $shipping_full in sdk/rocketnet.h — bump the header as part of the release."
      fail=1
    fi
    ;;
esac

exit $fail

set -euo pipefail

# every wire path is a tracked file before anything is compared:
# git log over a path that is gone prints nothing
python3 tools/check_wire_paths.py
wire_paths=$(python3 tools/check_wire_paths.py --print)

# versionsort.suffix=- sorts a prerelease (v1.0.0-preview-5) below
# its final release (v1.0.0); git's default puts it above.
newest_tag=$(git -c versionsort.suffix=- tag --list 'v*' --sort=-v:refname | head -n1)
if [ -z "$newest_tag" ]; then
  echo "::error::No v* tag is visible in this checkout, so there is no release to compare against. The checkout must fetch tags."
  exit 1
fi

total=$(git rev-list --count "$newest_tag"..HEAD)
echo "Newest tag: $newest_tag ($total commit(s) behind HEAD)"
if [ "$total" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "HEAD is exactly at $newest_tag."
  exit 0
fi

# WIRE-AFFECTING PATHS: tools/wire_paths.txt (why each kind is
# there, and why not the whole sdk, is at its head); this gate
# exists because a real wire change once shipped unannounced in a
# sibling. The paths hold no spaces (check_wire_paths.py: tracked
# files under sdk/ and standard/).

# shellcheck disable=SC2086
wire_log=$(git log --oneline "$newest_tag"..HEAD -- $wire_paths)

if [ -z "$wire_log" ]; then
  echo "HEAD is $total commit(s) past $newest_tag, none of them wire-affecting."
  exit 0
fi

count=$(printf '%s\n' "$wire_log" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')
{
  echo "## Unreleased wire-affecting changes"
  echo ""
  echo "HEAD is **$total** commit(s) past **$newest_tag**, and **$count** touch wire-affecting paths:"
  echo ""
  echo '```'
  printf '%s\n' "$wire_log"
  echo '```'
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

version=$(sed -nE 's/.*ROCKETNET_VERSION_FULL[[:space:]]+"(v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+(-[0-9A-Za-z.-]+)?)".*/\1/p' sdk/rocketnet.h | head -n1)
if [ -z "$version" ]; then
  echo "::error::Could not extract the v-prefixed shipping version from sdk/rocketnet.h."
  exit 1
fi
tag_version="$newest_tag"
if [ "$version" = "$tag_version" ]; then
  echo "::error::HEAD carries $count wire-affecting commit(s) past $newest_tag and the shipping version is still $version — nothing announces that a release is owed. Bump the shipping version in sdk/rocketnet.h (docs/RELEASING.md) or revert the wire change. The commit list is in the job summary."
  exit 1
fi
echo "::warning::HEAD carries $count wire-affecting commit(s) past $newest_tag. The version is already bumped to $version — tag $version when the release is ready. The commit list is in the job summary."

set -euo pipefail
WORK="${RUNNER_TEMP:-/tmp}/bigendian-system"
rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK"
cd "$WORK"

BASE=https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/noble/release
IMAGE=ubuntu-24.04-server-cloudimg-s390x.img
# Pinned fingerprint of the UEC Image Automatic Signing Key.
# Any other key is a failed verification, and the image is not used.
PIN=D2EB44626FDDC30B513D5BB71A5D6C4C7DB87C81

curl -fsSL -o SHA256SUMS "$BASE/SHA256SUMS"
curl -fsSL -o SHA256SUMS.gpg "$BASE/SHA256SUMS.gpg"
export GNUPGHOME="$WORK/gnupg"
mkdir -m 700 "$GNUPGHOME"
gpg --batch --keyid-format long --keyserver hkps://keyserver.ubuntu.com --recv-keys "$PIN"
FP=$(gpg --batch --with-colons --fingerprint "$PIN" | awk -F: '/^fpr:/ {print $10; exit}')
echo "signing-key fingerprint ${FP}"
test "$FP" = "$PIN"
gpg --batch --status-fd 1 --keyid-format long --verify SHA256SUMS.gpg SHA256SUMS | tee gpg-status.txt
grep -q '^\[GNUPG:\] GOODSIG ' gpg-status.txt
grep -q "^\[GNUPG:\] VALIDSIG ${PIN} " gpg-status.txt
curl -fL --retry 3 -o "$IMAGE" "$BASE/$IMAGE"
grep -F "*${IMAGE}" SHA256SUMS | sha256sum -c -

qemu-img create -f qcow2 -F qcow2 -b "$WORK/$IMAGE" "$WORK/overlay.qcow2" 8G
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f "$WORK/guest_key" -N "" -q
chmod 600 "$WORK/guest_key"
PUB=$(cat "$WORK/guest_key.pub")
cat > "$WORK/user-data" << EOF
#cloud-config
hostname: be-guest
resize_rootfs: true
ssh_pwauth: false
users:
  - name: runner
    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
    groups: sudo
    shell: /bin/bash
    lock_passwd: true
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - ${PUB}
EOF
printf 'instance-id: rn-be-1\nlocal-hostname: be-guest\n' > "$WORK/meta-data"
cloud-localds "$WORK/seed.img" "$WORK/user-data" "$WORK/meta-data"

PORT=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()')
echo "guest ssh port ${PORT}"
# the cross-endian run: a udp port forwarded to the guest's server,
# and one on this runner for the runner's server
GUEST_UDP_PORT=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()')
HOST_UDP_PORT=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM); s.bind(("0.0.0.0",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()')
echo "interop udp ports: guest ${GUEST_UDP_PORT}, runner ${HOST_UDP_PORT}"
# this runner's end of the cross-endian run: the same program built
# natively (little-endian x86-64), outside the tree copied to the guest
cmake -S "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" -B "$WORK/host-build" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-ffp-contract=off -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS=-ffp-contract=off > "$WORK/host-build.log" 2>&1
cmake --build "$WORK/host-build" --target bigendian_interop --parallel 4 >> "$WORK/host-build.log" 2>&1
cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/bin/bigendian_interop" "$WORK/bigendian_interop_host"
readelf -h "$WORK/bigendian_interop_host" | grep -F -q "little endian"
: > "$WORK/serial.log"
# The full-capacity unit cases (SUITE_CASE_RSS_BOUND) create a
# 1000-slot server whose plan is requested whole and mostly never
# touched. The guest kernel's overcommit admits such a block only
# if the guest holds it (docs/LOAD.md, the AF_XDP cell's guest
# memory): at 4 GiB the server create in
# test_server_stats_current_every_update is refused
# (ROCKETNET_STATUS_OUT_OF_MEMORY, mmap of 12275486720 bytes ENOMEM).
# The largest single request in the unit suite is 18886074368
# bytes; the whole unit and functional suites pass in a 32 GiB
# guest (x86_64 virtme-ng guest, 4 CPUs, 2026-11-11). Guest pages
# the suite does not touch cost the runner nothing.
start_guest() {
  qemu-system-s390x \
    -machine s390-ccw-virtio \
    -cpu max \
    -accel tcg,thread=multi \
    -m 32768 \
    -smp 4 \
    -display none \
    -serial file:"$WORK/serial.log" \
    -drive "file=$WORK/overlay.qcow2,if=none,id=hd0,format=qcow2,cache=writeback" \
    -device virtio-blk-ccw,drive=hd0,bootindex=1 \
    -drive "file=$WORK/seed.img,if=none,id=cidata,format=raw" \
    -device virtio-blk-ccw,drive=cidata \
    -netdev "user,id=net0,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:${PORT}-:22,hostfwd=udp:127.0.0.1:${GUEST_UDP_PORT}-:${GUEST_UDP_PORT}" \
    -device virtio-net-ccw,netdev=net0 \
    >"$WORK/qemu.log" 2>&1 &
  QEMU_PID=$!
}
cleanup() {
  if [ -n "${QEMU_PID:-}" ] && kill -0 "$QEMU_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
    kill "$QEMU_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
    wait "$QEMU_PID" 2>/dev/null || true
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT

SSH=(ssh -i "$WORK/guest_key" -p "$PORT"
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null
  -o IdentitiesOnly=yes
  -o ConnectTimeout=5
  runner@127.0.0.1)
SCP=(scp -i "$WORK/guest_key" -P "$PORT"
  -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no
  -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null
  -o IdentitiesOnly=yes)
# THE BOOT DEADLINE. The guest has booted when ssh answers; that
# took 17 tries (about 4 minutes) on run 43010917783. A guest with
# no ssh after boot_deadline seconds is killed and booted again from
# a fresh overlay, up to boot_attempts times, then the step fails
# by name. This bounds the boot only: the nightly opt-in
# (ROCKETNET_NIGHTLY_NO_TIMEOUT) lifts limits on test cases, and a
# guest that never booted runs none. Nothing below is bounded.
boot_deadline=1200
boot_attempts=3
ok=0
attempt=1
while [ "$attempt" -le "$boot_attempts" ]; do
  if [ "$attempt" -gt 1 ]; then
    rm -f "$WORK/overlay.qcow2"
    qemu-img create -f qcow2 -F qcow2 -b "$WORK/$IMAGE" "$WORK/overlay.qcow2" 8G
  fi
  start_guest
  boot_start=$SECONDS
  i=0
  why=""
  while :; do
    i=$((i + 1))
    if ! kill -0 "$QEMU_PID" 2>/dev/null; then
      why="qemu exited before ssh"
      break
    fi
    if "${SSH[@]}" true 2>/dev/null; then
      ok=1
      echo "ssh up at try ${i} of boot attempt ${attempt}, after $((SECONDS - boot_start)) s"
      break
    fi
    if [ $((SECONDS - boot_start)) -ge "$boot_deadline" ]; then
      why="no ssh after ${boot_deadline} s"
      break
    fi
    sleep 10
  done
  [ "$ok" = 1 ] && break
  echo "GUEST-DID-NOT-BOOT attempt ${attempt}/${boot_attempts}: ${why}"
  if [ -f "$WORK/serial.log" ]; then
    tail -n 40 "$WORK/serial.log"
  else
    echo "(no serial.log: qemu wrote no console)"
  fi
  cleanup
  attempt=$((attempt + 1))
done
if [ "$ok" != 1 ]; then
  echo "GUEST-DID-NOT-BOOT the s390x guest did not boot in ${boot_attempts} attempts (deadline ${boot_deadline} s each)"
  exit 1
fi

"${SSH[@]}" 'uname -sn; date -u'
tar -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --exclude .git --exclude build --exclude bin -cf "$WORK/src.tar" .
"${SCP[@]}" "$WORK/src.tar" "runner@127.0.0.1:src.tar"
"${SSH[@]}" 'mkdir -p ~/src && tar -C ~/src -xf ~/src.tar'
"${SSH[@]}" 'sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y build-essential cmake pkg-config libbpf-dev libxdp-dev xxd python3 time'
# TCG gives each case a fraction of a native CPU. Keep the Release
# workloads unchanged, but opt their completion bounds into the
# suites' stated 5x emulation scale.
# Bare --parallel lets Make launch every translation unit at once;
# bound compiler concurrency, not run time.
"${SSH[@]}" 'cd ~/src && cmake -B build -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_FLAGS=-ffp-contract=off -DCMAKE_CXX_FLAGS="-ffp-contract=off -DROCKETNET_TEST_EMULATED=1" && cmake --build build --target test functional bigendian_interop --parallel 2' 2>&1 | tee "$WORK/build.log"
"${SSH[@]}" 'cd ~/src && readelf -h bin/test && readelf -h bin/functional && readelf -h bin/test | grep -F -q "big endian" && readelf -h bin/test | grep -F -q "IBM S/390" && readelf -h bin/bigendian_interop | grep -F -q "big endian"'

suite_rc=0
"${SSH[@]}" bash -s << 'GUEST' || suite_rc=$?
set +e
export ROCKETNET_NIGHTLY_NO_TIMEOUT=1
cd ~/src
# The guest kernel's socket buffer ceiling is the stock 256 KiB, so
# the 8 MiB receive buffer the suite asks for is clamped and a
# receiver that the emulator stalls for a moment overflows. The
# fleet hosts that run the native suite grant 4 MiB; give the guest
# the same ceiling so it runs the suite on the same terms.
sudo sysctl -w net.core.rmem_max=4194304 net.core.wmem_max=4194304
uname -sn
date -u
rc=0
/usr/bin/time -f UNIT_SEC=%e ./bin/test 2>&1 | tee unit.out
u=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
echo UNIT_EXIT:$u
[ "$u" -eq 0 ] || rc=$u
/usr/bin/time -f FUNC_AUTO_SEC=%e bash tools/run_functional.sh s390x ./bin/functional 2>&1 | tee func_auto.out
a=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
echo FUNC_AUTO_EXIT:$a
[ "$a" -eq 0 ] || rc=$a
ROCKETNET_SERVER_TRANSPORT=portable ROCKETNET_CLIENT_TRANSPORT=portable /usr/bin/time -f FUNC_PORT_SEC=%e bash tools/run_functional.sh s390x-portable ./bin/functional 2>&1 | tee func_port.out
p=${PIPESTATUS[0]}
echo FUNC_PORT_EXIT:$p
[ "$p" -eq 0 ] || rc=$p
# Every case that failed in this run is replayed alone, three times,
# on the quiet guest. A case that passes alone was timing under the
# other work on the host; a case that fails alone is a defect to fix
# at its cause. Each replay prints its own exit and seconds.
# A runner-level failure prints "check failed: <case> exceeded|exit|signal ...".
# A unit case's own check prints
# "check failed: ( <condition> ), function <case>, file ..." and that
# function is the registered case name. The functional suite prints
# the same shape, but its function can be a helper shared by several
# cases, so only the unit suite is named from it.
replay() {
  label="$1"; bin="$2"; out="$3"; envs="$4"; from_function="$5"
  names=$(sed -n 's/^check failed: \(test_[a-z0-9_]*\) \(exceeded\|exit\|signal\).*/\1/p' "$out")
  if [ "$from_function" = 1 ]; then
    names="$names
$(sed -n 's/^check failed: ( .* ), function \(test_[a-z0-9_]*\), file .*/\1/p' "$out")"
  fi
  names=$(printf '%s\n' "$names" | sed '/^$/d' | sort -u)
  if [ -z "$names" ]; then
    if grep -q 'check failed:' "$out"; then
      echo "REPLAY_NO_CASE_NAME:$label a check failed with no case name in it; replay that case by hand"
    fi
    return 0
  fi
  for name in $names; do
    if [ -x "./bin/$name" ]; then
      target="./bin/$name"
      args=""
    else
      target="$bin"
      args="--run $name"
    fi
    i=1
    while [ "$i" -le 3 ]; do
      echo "REPLAY_BEGIN:$label:$name RUN:$i"
      env $envs /usr/bin/time -f "REPLAY_CASE:$name RUN:$i EXIT:%x SEC:%e" $target $args
      echo "REPLAY_END:$label:$name RUN:$i"
      i=$((i+1))
    done
  done
}
replay unit ./bin/test unit.out "" 1
replay func_auto ./bin/functional func_auto.out "" 0
replay func_port ./bin/functional func_port.out "ROCKETNET_SERVER_TRANSPORT=portable ROCKETNET_CLIENT_TRANSPORT=portable" 0
exit $rc
GUEST
echo "SUITE_EXIT:${suite_rc}"

# three clients each way: the keep-alive's client index and every
# per-client field take values other than zero
interop_rc=0
interop_start=$SECONDS
"$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/tools/bigendian/run_interop.sh" "$WORK/bigendian_interop_host" "$PORT" "$WORK/guest_key" "$GUEST_UDP_PORT" "$HOST_UDP_PORT" 3 || interop_rc=$?
echo "INTEROP_EXIT:${interop_rc} INTEROP_SEC:$((SECONDS - interop_start))"
[ "$suite_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$interop_rc" -eq 0 ]

column8:
set -euo pipefail
rm -rf "$WORK"
mkdir -p "$WORK"
cd "$WORK"

BASE="https://cloud-images.ubuntu.com/releases/${SERIES}/release"
IMAGE="ubuntu-${VERSION}-server-cloudimg-amd64.img"
# Pinned fingerprint of the UEC Image Automatic Signing Key.
# Any other key is a failed verification, and the image is not used.
PIN=D2EB44626FDDC30B513D5BB71A5D6C4C7DB87C81

curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o SHA256SUMS "$BASE/SHA256SUMS"
curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o SHA256SUMS.gpg "$BASE/SHA256SUMS.gpg"
export GNUPGHOME="$WORK/gnupg"
mkdir -m 700 "$GNUPGHOME"
gpg --batch --keyid-format long --keyserver hkps://keyserver.ubuntu.com --recv-keys "$PIN"
FP=$(gpg --batch --with-colons --fingerprint "$PIN" | awk -F: '/^fpr:/ {print $10; exit}')
echo "signing-key fingerprint ${FP}"
test "$FP" = "$PIN"
gpg --batch --status-fd 1 --keyid-format long --verify SHA256SUMS.gpg SHA256SUMS | tee gpg-status.txt
grep -q '^\[GNUPG:\] GOODSIG ' gpg-status.txt
grep -q "^\[GNUPG:\] VALIDSIG ${PIN} " gpg-status.txt
SUM=$(awk -v f="*${IMAGE}" '$2 == f {print $1}' SHA256SUMS)
test -n "$SUM"
echo "image ${IMAGE} sha256 ${SUM}"

CACHE="${XDG_CACHE_HOME:-$HOME/.cache}/rocketnet-nightly/cloud-images/${SERIES}"
mkdir -p "$CACHE"
CACHED="$CACHE/${SUM}.img"
# One leg per host per release fetches at a time; the others wait
# and then find the verified file.
exec 9>"$CACHE/.lock"
flock 9
if [ -f "$CACHED" ] && echo "${SUM}  ${CACHED}" | sha256sum -c --status -; then
  echo "cache hit ${CACHED}"
else
  echo "cache miss: downloading ${BASE}/${IMAGE}"
  rm -f "$CACHED" "$CACHE/download.tmp"
  curl -fL --retry 3 -o "$CACHE/download.tmp" "$BASE/$IMAGE"
  echo "${SUM}  $CACHE/download.tmp" | sha256sum -c -
  mv "$CACHE/download.tmp" "$CACHED"
fi
# Older point images of this release are not used again.
find "$CACHE" -maxdepth 1 -name '*.img' ! -name "${SUM}.img" -print -delete
# The overlay pins the image it was made from; keep a hard link in
# the work directory so a concurrent prune cannot remove it.
ln -f "$CACHED" "$WORK/base.img"
flock -u 9
echo "${SUM}  $WORK/base.img" | sha256sum -c -
set -euo pipefail
cd "$WORK"
qemu-img create -f qcow2 -F qcow2 -b "$WORK/base.img" "$WORK/overlay.qcow2" 24G
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f "$WORK/guest_key" -N "" -q
chmod 600 "$WORK/guest_key"
PUB=$(cat "$WORK/guest_key.pub")
cat > "$WORK/user-data" << EOF
#cloud-config
hostname: lts-guest
ssh_pwauth: false
package_update: false
package_upgrade: false
users:
  - name: runner
    sudo: ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL
    groups: sudo
    shell: /bin/bash
    lock_passwd: true
    ssh_authorized_keys:
      - ${PUB}
EOF
printf 'instance-id: rn-lts-%s-%s\nlocal-hostname: lts-guest\n' "$SERIES" "$GITHUB_RUN_ID" > "$WORK/meta-data"
cloud-localds "$WORK/seed.img" "$WORK/user-data" "$WORK/meta-data"

CPUS=$(( $(nproc) / 2 ))
[ "$CPUS" -le 8 ] || CPUS=8
[ "$CPUS" -ge 2 ] || CPUS=2
PORT=$(python3 -c 'import socket; s=socket.socket(); s.bind(("127.0.0.1",0)); print(s.getsockname()[1]); s.close()')
echo "$PORT" > "$WORK/port"
echo "guest ssh port ${PORT}, ${CPUS} vcpus, 24 GiB"
: > "$WORK/serial.log"
qemu-system-x86_64 \
  -machine q35,accel=kvm \
  -cpu host \
  -m 24576 \
  -smp "$CPUS" \
  -display none \
  -daemonize \
  -pidfile "$WORK/qemu.pid" \
  -serial file:"$WORK/serial.log" \
  -drive "file=$WORK/overlay.qcow2,if=virtio,format=qcow2,cache=writeback" \
  -drive "file=$WORK/seed.img,if=virtio,format=raw" \
  -netdev "user,id=net0,hostfwd=tcp:127.0.0.1:${PORT}-:22" \
  -device virtio-net-pci,netdev=net0 \
  >"$WORK/qemu.log" 2>&1
echo "qemu pid $(cat "$WORK/qemu.pid")"

# The steps below reach the guest through these two wrappers.
cat > "$WORK/g" << EOF
#!/bin/sh
exec ssh -i "$WORK/guest_key" -p "$PORT" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o ServerAliveInterval=30 -o LogLevel=ERROR runner@127.0.0.1 "\$@"
EOF
cat > "$WORK/gcp" << EOF
#!/bin/sh
exec scp -i "$WORK/guest_key" -P "$PORT" -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -o UserKnownHostsFile=/dev/null -o IdentitiesOnly=yes -o LogLevel=ERROR "\$@"
EOF
chmod +x "$WORK/g" "$WORK/gcp"

# THE BOOT DEADLINE: the only bounded wait here. A KVM guest answers
# ssh in under a minute (2026-10-28); one with no ssh after 300 s
# fails the step by name with the end of its serial console.
boot_deadline=300
boot_start=$SECONDS
ok=0
while [ $((SECONDS - boot_start)) -lt "$boot_deadline" ]; do
  if ! kill -0 "$(cat "$WORK/qemu.pid")" 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "GUEST-DID-NOT-BOOT qemu exited before ssh"
    tail -n 60 "$WORK/serial.log"
    exit 1
  fi
  if "$WORK/g" true 2>/dev/null; then
    ok=1
    echo "ssh up after $((SECONDS - boot_start)) s"
    break
  fi
  sleep 5
done
if [ "$ok" != 1 ]; then
  echo "GUEST-DID-NOT-BOOT no ssh after ${boot_deadline} s"
  tail -n 60 "$WORK/serial.log"
  exit 1
fi
# cloud-init must have finished (it writes the user and its key);
# its status is printed, and a guest whose cloud-init is not done
# fails here by name
"$WORK/g" 'cloud-init status --wait --long' > "$WORK/cloud-init.txt" 2>&1 || echo "cloud-init status exit $? (judged by its status line below)"
cat "$WORK/cloud-init.txt"
if ! grep -qE '^status: done' "$WORK/cloud-init.txt"; then
  echo "GUEST-CLOUD-INIT-NOT-DONE"
  exit 1
fi
set -euo pipefail
tar -C "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --exclude ./.git --exclude ./build --exclude ./bin -cf "$WORK/src.tar" .
"$WORK/gcp" "$WORK/src.tar" runner@127.0.0.1:src.tar
"$WORK/g" 'mkdir -p ~/src && tar -C ~/src -xf ~/src.tar && rm ~/src.tar'
set -euo pipefail
"$WORK/g" "sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get update -y && sudo DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ${PACKAGES}"
"$WORK/g" 'gcc --version | head -1; clang --version | head -1; cmake --version | head -1; dpkg-query -W libbpf-dev liburing-dev'
# The guest gets the socket buffer ceiling the fleet hosts grant.
"$WORK/g" 'sudo sysctl -w net.core.rmem_max=4194304 net.core.wmem_max=4194304'

grep -E '^nightly watch: ' nightly-watch.log > "$tmp/counts.txt" || [ $? -eq 1 ]
grep -E '^UNMEASURED ' nightly-watch.log > "$tmp/unmeasured.txt" || [ $? -eq 1 ]
{
  if [ "$status" = "0" ] && [ -s "$tmp/unmeasured.txt" ]; then
    echo "## nightly watch: UNMEASURED (not green; red after 7 nights without a measurement)"
  elif [ "$status" = "0" ]; then
    echo "## nightly watch: green"
  else
    echo "## nightly watch: RED (exit $status)"
  fi
  echo
  if [ -s "$tmp/red.txt" ]; then
    echo '```'
    cat "$tmp/red.txt"
    echo '```'
  fi
  echo
  if [ -s "$tmp/counts.txt" ]; then
    echo '```'
    cat "$tmp/counts.txt"
    echo '```'
  else
    echo "No counts line: the watch stopped before the end."
  fi
  echo
  echo '<details><summary>full listing</summary>'

  echo '```'

  echo '```'

} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

done < "$tmp/unmeasured.txt"

set -euo pipefail
slices=90
case "$MUTATION_WORKERS" in ''|*[!0-9]*|0) echo "mutation_workers must be a positive integer, not '$MUTATION_WORKERS'" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac
day=$(( $(date -u +%s) / 86400 ))
if [[ "$MUTATION_FULL" == 1 ]]; then
  slice_args=()
  slice="full (workflow_dispatch mutation_full: every slice, 0..$((slices - 1)) of $slices)"
else
  slice_args=(--slice "$((day % slices))/$slices")
  slice="$((day % slices))/$slices"
fi
# every survivor must be in the reviewed baseline; the gap count
# (MUTATION-GAPS) must equal its recorded ratchet and only goes down
rule="every survivor is in tools/mutation/survivors.tsv as equivalent or gap; new survivors, stale or killed entries, gone entries and a broken gap-ratchet fail"
rule_args=(--platform linux --baseline tools/mutation/survivors.tsv)
core=(
  sdk/rocketnet_token_tables.cpp
  sdk/rocketnet_encryption_map.cpp
  sdk/rocketnet_client_slots.cpp
  sdk/rocketnet_replay.cpp
  sdk/rocketnet_window_receive.cpp
  sdk/rocketnet_window_send.cpp
)
for f in "${core[@]}"; do
  if [[ ! -f "$f" ]]; then
    echo "missing core file: $f" >&2
    exit 1
  fi
done
# one more day than there are slices: a file changed today is in the
# list for every slice of the next cycle
changed="$(git log --since="$((slices + 1)) days ago" --name-only --pretty=format: -- sdk | sed '/^$/d' | sort -u)"
files=("${core[@]}")
while IFS= read -r f; do
  [[ "$f" =~ ^sdk/.+\.(c|cc|cpp|cxx|h|hh|hpp|hxx|inc)$ ]] || continue
  [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
  skip=0
  for have in "${files[@]}"; do
    if [[ "$have" == "$f" ]]; then
      skip=1
      break
    fi
  done
  if [[ "$skip" -eq 0 ]]; then
    files+=("$f")
  fi
done <<< "$changed"
mkdir -p build/mutation
{
  echo "date_utc=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)"
  echo "day_number=$day"
  echo "slice=$slice"
  echo "slices=$slices"
  echo "ref=$MUTATION_REF"
  echo "head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
  echo "workers=$MUTATION_WORKERS"
  echo "run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID attempt=$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT"
  echo "rule=$rule"
  echo "files=${files[*]}"
} > build/mutation/slice.txt
echo "MUTATION-SLICE $slice of the full list (day $day, UTC $(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)); the $slices slices cover every mutant every $slices nights"
echo "MUTATION-RULE $rule"
printf 'mutation files:\n'
printf '  %s\n' "${files[@]}"
exec python3 tools/mutation/run_mutants.py --max-mutants 0 ${slice_args[@]+"${slice_args[@]}"} ${rule_args[@]+"${rule_args[@]}"} --workers "$MUTATION_WORKERS" --out build/mutation/results.json --summary-md build/mutation/summary.md --files "${files[@]}"

set -euo pipefail
ulimit -n 65536 || ulimit -n "$(ulimit -Hn)"
check_cell() {
  cell=$1; want=$2; line=$3
  echo "LOAD cell=$cell $line"
  case "$line" in *verdict=PASS*) ;; *) echo "LOAD cell=$cell FAIL"; return 1 ;; esac
  case "$line" in *"server_transport_io=$want "*) ;; *) echo "LOAD cell=$cell wrong server transport (want $want)"; return 1 ;; esac
  # each field must be present: sed -n ... p prints nothing for an
  # absent field, and an empty value fails rather than comparing equal
  fs=$(echo "$line" | sed -nE "s/.* fds_start=([0-9]+)( .*|$)/\1/p"); fe=$(echo "$line" | sed -nE "s/.* fds_end=([0-9]+)( .*|$)/\1/p")
  ts=$(echo "$line" | sed -nE "s/.* threads_start=([0-9]+)( .*|$)/\1/p"); te=$(echo "$line" | sed -nE "s/.* threads_end=([0-9]+)( .*|$)/\1/p")
  [ -n "$fs" ] && [ -n "$fe" ] && [ -n "$ts" ] && [ -n "$te" ] || { echo "LOAD cell=$cell FAIL the line lacks fds_start, fds_end, threads_start or threads_end"; return 1; }
  [ "$fs" = "$fe" ] && [ "$ts" = "$te" ] || { echo "LOAD cell=$cell fd or thread growth"; return 1; }
}
run_cell() {
  cell=$1; want=$2; shift 2
  out=$(mktemp)
  status=0
  env "$@" ./bin/load 1000 60 > "$out" || status=$?
  line=$(sed -n '/^load: connected/p' "$out" | tail -n 1)
  [ "$status" = 0 ] || { echo "LOAD cell=$cell $line"; echo "LOAD cell=$cell FAIL load exited $status"; return 1; }
  check_cell "$cell" "$want" "$line"
}
